end.summary:
Introduced numbers 11–20 as one ten and extra ones.
Saanvi explained 11 as ten plus one.
Saanvi identified 14 as one ten and four ones, then mixed up the bundle count with the total.
The confusion about 14 remained when the lesson ended; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised showing numbers as one bundle of ten plus loose ones. Using sticks, they explained 11 as ten and one, and later stated that 14 is one ten and four ones; they then mixed up counting the bundle with counting the total, and this was not corrected before stopping. At home, build one bundle of ten and add loose sticks for 11–20, asking, “How many tens? How many ones? What is the total?”
